title: Whole Number Fractions with Unit Interval 1
objective: Express whole number fractions on the number line when the unit interval is 1.

problems.text: Label the following models as a fraction inside the dotted box.
Fill in the missing whole numbers in the boxes below the number line. Rename the whole numbers as fractions in the boxes above the number line.
Explain the difference between these two fractions with words and pictures: 2/1 and 2/2
